notes.title: Build 0.9.21 Release
notes.content:
We've released version 0.9.21 of the BETA.  There are several internal fixes, but those you will likely notice are:

- relics now scatter when dropped.  We believe this will help with competition by making it harder for one dragon to pick them up.

- more relics have been added and/or changed with more lore.  We still have some details to fill in, but the base selection of relics will be the same.

--Development

notes.title: Dragon Souls v0.9.20 Update
notes.content:
We've accomplished a few things in this build which should allow us to keep the servers running for a while.  We had anticipated focused play times, but it may not work with all players.  Therefore, we will continue to leave the servers running, but we suggest everyone wishing to play against other players try between the times of 6-9pm EST.

Please report any further issues to http://www.dragon-souls.com/Feedback 

And, as always, thank you for your patience as we work through this initial release.

Bug Fixes

- Fixed a problem where all players were launched into the next game, regardless if they were queued or not.
- Players should now be able to exit the ‘Winner Screen’ and return to the lobby consistently.
- Fixed a problem where relic inventory could not be changed.  Players can now move relics around to optimize which relics are in use.
- More movement controls are now available in the lobby.


New Additions

- We’ve switched the default keyboard layout to a WASD setup and enabled mouse buttons for remapping keys.  Keys can be remapped in game through the "Controls" menu.
- We’ve added lore for the relics.  When you’ve captured a relic, enter your den to get the full story.  Some relics are due more information, so we will continue to expand on this.

notes.title: Servers down until new build is released
notes.content:
We have brought the servers down in preparation for a new build and to schedule more focused play times.

Our next build will include:

- WASD key mappings and more customization to controls
- fixes to end-of-game connection issues
- fixes to relic inventory management (assigning relics to action bar)
- the addition of lore through relic inventory.  Players can read up on each relic

We will post more here soon on the schedule.

--The Dragon Souls Team
